title.value: Towards Reliable Misinformation Mitigation: Generalization, Uncertainty, and GPT-4
title.justification: The title matches the content and focus of the paper, which is about addressing misinformation using models like GPT-4, focusing on generalization and uncertainty.
title.quote: Abstract Misinformation poses a critical societal challenge, and current approaches have yet to produce an effective solution. We propose focusing on generalization, uncertainty, and how to leverage recent large language models, in order to create more practical tools to evaluate information veracity.

extractions.description: This paper explores the use of GPT-4 in misinformation mitigation, focusing on generalization and uncertainty. It introduces techniques to handle uncertainty and discusses the development of the LIAR-New dataset for evaluating misinformation. The paper aims to lay the groundwork for more practical systems in combating misinformation.

new_primary_sub_category.value: AI and Language Models in Misinformation
new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper specifically examines the role of large language models in addressing misinformation, exploring their use in evaluating the veracity of statements.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: We examine three datasets: the widely-used LIAR, CT-FAN-22, and a new dataset LIAR-New.
